VENUE CORRECTED throughout: the sleeve trades Binance USD-M perps; the MT5 screenshots were the origin of the idea and one data point on trail width, never the venue. run_trade_review.py reads each closed trade against what was claimed at entry and classifies the cause into something actionable (THESIS-WRONG / LEVEL-WRONG / TIMING-WRONG / NOISE-STOP / RIGHT-AND-PAID / RIGHT-BUT-TRUNCATED / UNLUCKY -- that last one load-bearing, since a desk that cannot tell right-and-unlucky from wrong will 'fix' a working process), then extracts ONE falsifiable lesson. The playbook is an EVIDENCE LADDER: PROVISIONAL on one observation with no authority, SUPPORTED after 3 agreeing trades, RETIRED the moment one contradicts it with the contradiction recorded, STALE after 25 untested trades. Only SUPPORTED lessons reach the brief. Outcomes are also CONDITIONED ON SETUP (trend alignment, vol regime, position in range, level touches, horizon) because one global hit rate hides everything actionable -- 55pct with the 4h trend and 25pct against reads as a mediocre 40pct, and the fix is invisible until it is split. docs/DISCRETIONARY_DESK.md states the section, its organs, its method and what 300pct actually requires: a ~38pct hit rate against a 31.1pct cost-adjusted breakeven.

recommendations.summary: COPYTRADING SCREENED, Stage A, zero promotion authority. Two hypotheses, opposite verdicts. H1 FOLLOW A LEAD TRADER: ABANDONED as untestable from public data. The naive split-half test on 34 OKX lead traders returns Spearman +0.33 with 5/6 of the top quintile beating the median -- and it is an artifact: cohort SELECTED ON THE OUTCOME (sorted by pnl/aum/copiers/winRatio then measured for performance), blown-up traders absent entirely so persistence is manufactured by the survival filter, mean 45d return +81pct across the sample (a leaderboard, not a population), n=34 giving ~1.9 sigma BEFORE either bias. Economics add a 13pct copier profit share, entry lag behind the lead, and the lead's full drawdown. H2 TRADE THE COPY FLOW: KEPT and measured. Copy capital is FORCED flow -- copiers enter behind the lead, exit when it exits, liquidate together -- so aggregate skew and stress are a crowding gauge needing no winner picked, which is exactly why it dodges the selection problem. Live: 164 positions, median leverage 20x, 52pct underwater. Screen archives a FORWARD PANEL counting disappearances as FAILURES, the only unbiased design; NO-DATA until two snapshots sit 5+ days apart. Judged against max E[log wealth]: a sleeve adding only crypto beta adds ~nothing, so any promotion must show DIVERSIFYING return.
recommendations.reason: Stage A run live; H1 abandoned on measurement, H2 on a forward clock
recommendations.note: two bugs found by checking my own numbers: the crowding gauge reported an outlier-dominated -0.97 as its centre when the median was -0.078, and posSide 'net' (46pct of margin) was being silently dropped from the long/short skew
